premises.text: Managing community organizations is challenging due to the use of multiple platforms.
premises.evidence_span: managing those organizations has been incredibly challenging. I've had to use five platforms to stay organized.

premises.text: Community organizers need a single solution for engagement.
premises.evidence_span: Cohort connects community. What I mean by that, it is the single solution that an organizer needs to engage their membership.

premises.text: Cohort provides integrated tools for communication, event, member, and transaction management.
premises.evidence_span: Communication management, event management, member management, transaction management under one umbrella.

premises.text: Groups can manage hierarchical structures and subgroups online.
premises.evidence_span: Each group can have as many subgroups as they want and as many tiers of subgroups as they need.

premises.text: Cohort allows for social interaction among group members.
premises.evidence_span: groups are also social in the real world. They do events together.

premises.text: Cohort enables users to control how their information is shared.
premises.evidence_span: We've created a very simple lexicon of public, private, and hidden.

premises.text: Cohort generates revenue through subscriptions and service fees.
premises.evidence_span: We generate revenue by selling subscriptions against our channels and free groups.
